purpose: Contract for turning the Atris brain into a spectacle-grade pitch deck and explorable dynamic page.

positioning.oneLine: Atris turns brain state into working software surfaces.
positioning.deckMetaphor: The deck is the creation and manifestation from the brain.
positioning.productMetaphor: A dynamic page is a living deck where each claim is backed by blocks.
positioning.flipbookContrast: Pure pixels are magic; blocks are magic you can edit, rerun, verify, and turn into an app.

slideBlocks.headline: The brain becomes the product
slideBlocks.purpose: Show that context, memory, tasks, apps, and generated media become one rendered surface.

slideBlocks.headline: Blocks are manifestation units
slideBlocks.purpose: Explain app, code, image, deck, and receipt blocks as composable primitives.

slideBlocks.headline: APP.md says what the customer gets
slideBlocks.purpose: Connect app manifests to rendered product blocks.

slideBlocks.headline: The surface appears on demand
slideBlocks.purpose: Show generated UI assembled from block schemas, not hand-made static pages.

slideBlocks.headline: The product can visualize itself
slideBlocks.purpose: Use AtrisOS-theme image generation as a first-class block output.

slideBlocks.headline: Every spectacle has receipts
slideBlocks.purpose: Show prompts, code, assets, checks, and lineage behind the deck.

prototypeFlow: User states the pitch or product idea.
Atris loads memory, APP.md manifests, and block schemas.
Code blocks extract the story and build live UI.
Deck blocks compose the spectacle presentation.
Receipt blocks prove each artifact and action.

dynamicDeck.definition: A presentation that behaves like a live product surface: each slide is a block-backed scene that can explain, generate, execute, inspect, and transform while the viewer watches.
interactionModel: Presenter can ask the deck to explain any claim.
Audience can click a region and reveal the block behind it.
A slide can generate a new visual or UI state live.
A code block can run and update the slide output.
A receipt pane can show provenance for prompts, files, assets, and checks.

sceneTypes.narrative: Founder story, market insight, product thesis.
sceneTypes.modelGenerated: AtrisOS-theme image or video-like visual generated from the current idea.
sceneTypes.structuredUi: Real UI panel generated from block schemas.
sceneTypes.liveCode: Runnable prototype or transform shown inside the deck.

dynamicDeck.antiGoal: Do not make a static slide deck with pretty screenshots. The deck should be the product performing.

nonNegotiables: The deck must feel like the product, not a document about the product.
The dynamic page must be explorable, with visible block lineage.
The image style must use the AtrisOS product-surface contract.
Every slide should be representable as a block.
